constraint:curvature.pill-containers.title: Cards are not near pills: with radius-scale ≥ 2 the concentric card radius approaches half a short card's height unless radius-card lowers it.

constraint:density.compact-border.title: At compact density the 0.5u control inset can hold the border twice (a composite's edge and its option's), B ≤ 0.25u; otherwise one-row composites grow past the control height.

constraint:elevation.floating-visible.title: Floating surfaces (menus, popovers, select popups, toasts) separate from the page: a floating elevation above 0dp, or a border.

constraint:elevation.modal-shadow.title: Modal surfaces cast a shadow (shadow-modal > 0dp); with none, only the backdrop separates a dialog from the page.

constraint:elevation.surfaces-visible.title: Panels and cards separate from the page: surface-contrast > 0, or cards are raised with a shadow.

constraint:emphasis.on-solid.title: Text on the primary and critical solids (step 9: filled buttons, danger actions) reaches APCA Lc 60, the level for UI text, in light and dark.

constraint:movement.feedback-fast.title: Hover and press feedback settles within 0.3s (the feedback intent's spring duration × motion-scale).

constraint:movement.reveal-bounce.title: The reveal intent (popups, dialogs, drawers opening) does not overshoot: it does not run the bouncy spring while it bounces.

constraint:scale.target-size.title: The control height at the theme root, (6 + 2I) × u, is at least 24px (WCAG 2.5.8 target size).

constraint:typography.face-weights.title: Each voice's face (by its first family, in the face catalogue) has the weights the type roles on that voice use; bold (600+) needs a face that goes to 600.

constraint:typography.web-face-source.title: A face whose catalogue entry is a web face (Google) has a typography.sources entry, so it actually loads.

constraint:vibrancy.anchor-order.title: An anchored step's Lc against the light page stays strictly between its neighbor steps' targets, so the ramp keeps its contrast order.

constraint:vibrancy.anchor-range.title: An anchor's Lc against the light page lies within the ramp (step 2's target / 2 to step 12's target + 10).

constraint:vibrancy.text-contrast.title: Each brand and feedback role's text step (11) reaches the engine's APCA threshold on the page fill, in light and dark.

descriptor:adaptivity.title: Adaptivity: which scheme the theme leads with

descriptor:adaptivity.both.title: Adaptivity both: follows the OS (the default)

descriptor:adaptivity.dark-first.title: Adaptivity dark-first: dark unless the reader switches

descriptor:adaptivity.light-first.title: Adaptivity light-first: light unless the reader switches

descriptor:corner.title: Corner shape: the curve of a corner

descriptor:corner.bevel.title: Corner shape bevel: straight cut corners

descriptor:corner.round.title: Corner shape round: circular arcs (the default)

descriptor:corner.squircle.title: Corner shape squircle: superellipse, continuous curvature

descriptor:curvature.pill.title: Curvature pill: controls are pills; containers very round

descriptor:density.title: Density: how much fits at the same scale

descriptor:elevation.flat.title: Elevation flat: fills separate levels; popups keep a faint shadow

descriptor:elevation.floating.title: Elevation floating: cards lift off the page; shadows carry the hierarchy

descriptor:elevation.layered.title: Elevation layered: the default: fills for inline levels, shadows for lifted ones

descriptor:emphasis.title: Emphasis: how strongly a selection shows

descriptor:emphasis.balanced.title: Emphasis balanced: the page-tone chip in light, the primary solid in dark (the default)

descriptor:emphasis.loud.title: Emphasis loud: a primary tint in light: selection carries the brand

descriptor:emphasis.quiet.title: Emphasis quiet: a muted neutral fill; the primary stays for actions

descriptor:harmony.triadic.title: Harmony triadic: three evenly spaced hues

descriptor:harmony.unique.title: Harmony unique: evenly spread unique hues (the default)

descriptor:iconography.title: Iconography: the icon set and its drawing

descriptor:iconography.phosphor.title: Iconography phosphor: rounded, friendly strokes with many weights (the default)

descriptor:line.title: Line: how much outline controls carry

descriptor:line.borderless.title: Line borderless: fills alone define controls

descriptor:movement.calm.title: Movement calm: slower, almost no overshoot

descriptor:movement.playful.title: Movement playful: toggles run on the bouncy spring too

descriptor:movement.still.title: Movement still: short, critically damped transitions

descriptor:neutral.title: Neutral: how much the neutrals carry the hue

descriptor:neutral.subtle.title: Neutral subtle: a hint of the hue

descriptor:neutral.tinted.title: Neutral tinted: neutrals lean toward the hue (the default)

descriptor:scale.xl.title: Scale xl: large, kiosk or display (48px)

descriptor:space.title: Space: margins and gutters: container padding and gaps

descriptor:type-scale.title: Type scale: how far headings step from body text

descriptor:type-scale.classic.title: Type scale classic: perfect fourth (the default)

descriptor:type-scale.dramatic.title: Type scale dramatic: perfect fifth: editorial, display-led

descriptor:type-scale.flat.title: Type scale flat: major second: quiet hierarchy, dense UI

descriptor:vibrancy.title: Vibrancy: how saturated the palette is

descriptor:vibrancy.muted.title: Vibrancy muted: low chroma, greyed accents

descriptor:vibrancy.vivid.title: Vibrancy vivid: full chroma the gamut allows (the default)

parameters:curvature.title: Curvature: radius scale s and corner shape k

parameters:type-scale.title: Type scale: ratio r and rhythm
